description: Set up Felix for this owner from inside the chat: asks the owner to accept the Felix Terms of Service, Privacy Policy and Risk Disclosure, then creates the owner key in macOS Keychain, registers the launcher, writes and verifies the encrypted recovery file, and loads the identity into this session (no restart). When the MCP client can show questions, Felix asks the owner directly. Otherwise the first call returns the exact question: ask the owner in chat, and only if they say yes call again with owner_accepted_terms:true and terms_version; macOS then shows one native confirmation the owner must click. Never answer for the owner. Local stdio only. No key or recovery code is returned.

owner_accepted_terms.description: Only when the client cannot ask the owner directly: true after the owner answered yes, in this chat, to the exact question this tool returned.

terms_version.description: The terms version the owner accepted, exactly as returned by the first call.

name: onboard
